1.consolidated_definition: Pájaro de hasta 14 cm de longitud, con alas cortas y redondeadas y cola ahorquillada, de plumaje verde oliva en la parte superior y amarillo en la parte inferior. Vireonidae; Vireo gundlachii.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Bird of up to 14 cm in length, with short and rounded wings and a forked tail, having olive-green plumage on the upper part and yellow on the lower part. Vireonidae; Vireo gundlachii.
